svg.aria-label: Crisis navigation chart: If I'm not OK — what to do. Start: "Am I safe right now?". Steps: from "Am I safe right now?", if No / unsafe go to "Call/text a crisis line or emergency"; from "Am I safe right now?", if Yes go to "What do I feel?"; from "What do I feel?", if Revved up go to "TIPP / cold water / breathe"; from "What do I feel?", if Shut down go to "Move / orient / reach support"; from "TIPP / cold water / breathe", go to "Still stuck after 15 min?"; from "Move / orient / reach support", go to "Still stuck after 15 min?"; from "Still stuck after 15 min?", if Yes go to "Call my support person"; from "Still stuck after 15 min?", if No go to "Back in my window — OK for now". Crisis resources are always shown: If you are in danger now, call your local emergency number or a crisis line (use your local number).
